metadata.description: REQUIRED. Your Cosmos DB endpoint. Example: https://your-cosmos-account.documents.azure.com:443/
Optional. Embedding service endpoint URL. Only needed for vector_search / hybrid_search tools. Supports Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, or OpenAI.
Optional. Embedding model deployment name. Only needed for vector_search / hybrid_search tools. Common values: text-embedding-3-small, text-embedding-3-large
Optional. Set to true to enable Entra ID authentication for inbound MCP requests. When false (default), the server accepts unauthenticated requests.
Set to true to use an existing Azure Container Registry instead of creating one
Existing Azure Container Registry name (required when useExistingAcr=true)
Resource group containing the existing ACR (defaults to deployment resource group when empty)
Optional: Microsoft Foundry project resource ID for assigning Entra App role. Format: /subscriptions/{sub}/resourceGroups/{rg}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/{project}
